Bamburgh

A spectacular coastal village overlooked by one of England's most iconic castles, with miles of sandy beach and some of Northumberland's finest scenery.

THE LOWDOWN

Why visit Bamburgh?

Bamburgh is one of those places that feels instantly recognisable. Its huge castle dominates the skyline above a sweeping stretch of golden sand, while the village itself offers places to eat, drink and explore. Whether you're visiting for the castle, the beach, the views or simply a day by the coast, Bamburgh is one of Northumberland's essential places to experience.

HIGHLIGHTS

Things to see & do

Bamburgh Castle

Explore the spectacular castle that dominates the village and coastline, with centuries of history and impressive views across the North Sea.

Bamburgh Beach

Walk the huge sweep of sandy beach beneath the castle and take in views across to the Farne Islands.

The Village

Wander through Bamburgh's small collection of shops, cafés, pubs and places to stop for something to eat.

GOOD TO KNOW

Before you go

GETTING THERE

Bamburgh is on the Northumberland coast, around 15 minutes from Alnwick by car. The nearest railway station is at Chathill.

BEST TIME TO VISIT

Early morning and late afternoon are particularly good for quieter walks, softer light and fewer visitors.

PARKING

Several car parks are available in and around the village, with additional parking close to the beach.
